protocol: prepare X+, then reads a,X,a,X,...; quantum agreement 4/5 per read; complete public record
resource_statement: Necessity: with B fair fresh bits per slot and a time-independent update, T(h)->1 whenever the persistent state set is finite; so a controller keeping T(h) bounded below 1 at every depth needs the number of persistent states reachable within h slots, from a finite initial support, to grow without bound in h. Growth is not sufficient by itself: the a2_depth_v7 full-record memoryless controllers have growing state and T(h)->1. One controller with linearly growing private memory, the a2_depth_v7 retained-seed reset granted the target cuts, keeps T<=1/(2^B-2) at every depth for B>=2. The least sufficient growth rate is not determined here.
scope: A2 only. The class theorem covers bounded persistent state with a time-independent update and B fair fresh bits per slot, on this protocol; it gives no rate. Not covered: bounded private memory with unbounded public state (an unbounded clock or full-record dependence), time-dependent updates, growing per-slot blocks, non-dyadic sources, other protocols, A1 or OI. The RS depths are certified for the tested members only; no growth law is fitted.
